name: Evidence Fixtures
author: KyaniteLabs
description: The evidence-contracts pattern, packaged as a ResonantOS add-on: a reference engine that runs the resonantos-economy-research community's own contribution-edge fixtures and proves their typed negatives hold with every effect field (reward, authority, policy, governance, payout) at none and implementation_status at fixture_only. Built by grafting kinocut's record-contract discipline (closed record schemas, unknown-fields-fail-on-read, hash-bound identity, typed negatives) onto the community's existing non-collapse defaults. Read-only: it parses fixture files and writes only its own var/receipt.json, which always banners 'fixture run receipt — not economy validation'. Runs standalone (python3 engine.py <fixtures-dir>) or through a hardened loopback local service.

grantPresets.label: Run contribution-edge fixtures
grantPresets.description: Allow Evidence Fixtures to read the seven pinned files of a contribution-edge-fixtures directory (six fixture files plus TYPED-NEGATIVES.md) to run their pass/fail checks. Read-only: fixture files are never modified, and the only bytes written are this add-on's own var/receipt.json.

tools.name: contractsgift.status
tools.description: Report service health: ok flag, addon id, engine version, receipt schema, the receipt banner, and the last fixture run outcome. Takes no parameters.

banner.description: Always: fixture run receipt — not economy validation

last_run.description: all_pass and fixture_set_hash of the most recent run, or null

receipt_path.description: Addon-relative path of the receipt file

tools.name: contractsgift.run_fixtures
tools.description: Run the pinned contribution-edge fixture package from an absolute fixtures directory path: parses each fixture's embedded record strictly (unknown or missing fields fail loudly), asserts all five effect fields stay none and implementation_status stays fixture_only, verifies all seven typed negatives hold (the two meta-negatives hold by construction), and writes the deterministic receipt to var/receipt.json. Pass/fail only — the output cannot express reward, credit, payout, policy, governance, launch, economy validation, or implementation readiness. Fixture files are read-only and the directory must contain the seven pinned files.

fixtures_dir.description: Absolute path to the contribution-edge-fixtures directory (must contain the six fixture files and TYPED-NEGATIVES.md)

fixture_set_hash.description: sha256 over the full read set (all six fixture files and TYPED-NEGATIVES.md)

file.description: Fixture file basename only; never an absolute path
